### Pipeline 2: Wan 2.2 14B MoE Video Generator (From Approved Keyframes)
**Purpose:** Animates your approved **Start Frame** (and optional **End Frame**) into a 24 fps shot using Wan 2.2's Mixture-of-Experts dual-model handoff.

- **Why Two 14B Models?**
  1. **Pass 1 — High-Noise Expert (Nodes `7`, `19`):** Runs steps `0 -> 12` to establish macro camera movement, body trajectory, and physics. *(No character LoRA here so motion stays fluid.)*
  2. **Pass 2 — Low-Noise Expert (Nodes `8`, `10`, `20`):** Takes over at step `12 -> 24` with your **Character Wan 2.2 LoRA** (`0.85`) to lock crisp facial identity, eyes, and skin texture.
- **Wan `4k + 1` Frame Rule:** Node `17` (`length`) must always equal `4k + 1` (e.g., `81` frames = 3.375s, `121` frames = 5.0s at 24 fps).
- **Dual Outputs:** Saves both a **Lossless FFV1 Master `.mkv`** (Node `22`, for zero-loss frame slicing) and a **H.264 Preview `.mp4`** (Node `23`, for smooth scrubbing in Director Studio).

_meta.title: 📖 READ FIRST — Pipeline 2: Wan 2.2 Dual-Expert MoE Video
_meta.description: Explains the High-Noise -> Low-Noise MoE handoff, character LoRA placement, 4k+1 frame math, and lossless master output.

_meta.title: [1] Load Approved Start Keyframe
_meta.description: Loads the Start Frame approved in Director Studio (or handed off from the final frame of the previous shot).

_meta.title: [2] Load Approved End Keyframe (Optional Anchor)
_meta.description: Loads the optional End Frame anchor so Wan 2.2 interpolates smoothly from Start pose to End pose.

_meta.title: [3] Load UMT5-XXL Text Encoder (Multilingual Motion Prompting)
_meta.description: Encodes motion, camera movement, and acting beats for Wan 2.2.

_meta.title: [4] Load Wan 3D Causal Video VAE (4x Temporal Compression)
_meta.description: 3D causal VAE that compresses every 4 frames temporally after frame 0 — the reason frame counts follow 4k + 1.

inputs.text: smooth natural camera push-in, character breathes and turns head gently, cinematic film lighting

_meta.title: [5] Motion & Camera Positive Prompt
_meta.description: Focus on physical motion, camera work (push-in, pan, handheld), and emotional micro-expressions rather than re-describing static clothes.

inputs.text: static, morphing face, extra limbs, jitter, flicker, low quality

_meta.title: [6] Motion Negative Prompt
_meta.description: Suppresses temporal flicker, face morphing, frozen frames, and limb duplication.

_meta.title: [7] Load Wan 2.2 High-Noise 14B Expert (Macro Motion)
_meta.description: First-stage 14B MoE expert responsible for blocking out camera motion and body physics during noisy early steps.

_meta.title: [8] Load Wan 2.2 Low-Noise 14B Expert (Identity & Fine Detail)
_meta.description: Second-stage 14B MoE expert responsible for facial likeness, eyes, hands, fabric, and lighting detail.

_meta.title: [9] Optional LightX2V Fast-Distill LoRA (High-Noise — 0.0 Off / 1.0 Fast)
_meta.description: Set to 1.0 (along with Node 11 and 4–8 total steps) for rapid draft previews; keep at 0.0 for full 24-step cinema quality.

_meta.title: [10] Character Wan 2.2 Low-Noise LoRA (0.85)
_meta.description: Applies your private character Wan 2.2 LoRA exclusively to the Low-Noise expert so identity stays locked without stiffening body motion.

_meta.title: [11] Optional LightX2V Fast-Distill LoRA (Low-Noise — 0.0 Off / 1.0 Fast)
_meta.description: Companion fast-distill toggle for Pass 2. Keep 0.0 for master renders.

_meta.title: [12] High-Noise Flow-Match Shift (6.0)
_meta.description: Sets the timestep schedule shift (5.0–7.0) for 720p Wan 2.2 flow-matching on Pass 1.

_meta.title: [13] Low-Noise Flow-Match Shift (6.0)
_meta.description: Matches Pass 1's timestep shift (6.0) so the step-12 handoff is seamless.

inputs.text:
### Optional Driving Video Control (Nodes 14–16 & 18)
Want your character to copy an actor's real head turn, walk cycle, or hand gesture? Supply a `driving_video_path` in Chat or Director Studio:
- **Node 15 (`DWPreprocessor`)** extracts body + face + finger skeletons.
- **Node 16 (`DepthAnythingV2`)** extracts 3D scene depth.
- **Node 18 (`WanFunControlToVideo`)** blends the motion guide when `strength > 0.0` (default `0.0` = pure keyframe-driven I2V).

_meta.title: 🎭 OPTIONAL MOTION CONTROL (DWPose + Depth + Fun-Control)
_meta.description: Explains optional driving-video pose/depth conditioning.

_meta.title: [14] Load Optional Driving Reference Video (24 fps)
_meta.description: Reference performance clip used only when Fun-Control strength (Node 18) is above 0.0.

_meta.title: [15] Extract DWPose Body + Hand + Face Skeleton
_meta.description: Tracks body, facial landmarks, and articulated fingers from the driving video.

_meta.title: [16] Extract DepthAnythingV2 Spatial Map
_meta.description: Computes per-frame depth maps from the driving video for optional spatial blocking.

_meta.title: [17] Build Wan 2.2 Start/End Video Latents (Length = 4k + 1)
_meta.description: Packs Start/End keyframes into a 1280x720 video latent volume. Length MUST be 4k+1 (e.g., 49, 81, 97, 121).

_meta.title: [18] Apply Fun-Control Pose Guide (0.0 = Disabled, 0.65 = Active)
_meta.description: When strength is 0.0, passes Start/End conditioning untouched; raise to 0.5–0.8 to follow the DWPose driving performance.

_meta.title: [19] MoE Pass 1: High-Noise Sampler (Steps 0 -> 12, Keep Noise)
_meta.description: Runs the first half of denoising with the High-Noise 14B expert and hands leftover noise directly to Node 20.

_meta.title: [20] MoE Pass 2: Low-Noise Sampler + Character LoRA (Steps 12 -> 24)
_meta.description: Resumes at step 12 without adding fresh noise, refining facial identity and sharp details to completion.

_meta.title: [21] Decode Wan 3D Video Latents to Frames
_meta.description: Decodes the finished temporal latent volume into 1280x720 RGB video frames.

_meta.title: [22] Save Lossless Archival Master (FFV1 .mkv @ 24 fps)
_meta.description: Mathematically lossless master used for exact frame extraction and zero-generation-loss Pause-and-Pivot splicing.

_meta.title: [23] Save Web Preview Clip (H.264 .mp4 @ 24 fps)
_meta.description: Browser-ready H.264 MP4 streamed into the Director Studio Timeline scrubber.
